opti-2: Wading birds hunt in the shallow marsh.
opti-3: But something new is hiding in the grass.
opti-4: Where pythons spread, scientists saw far fewer raccoons and rabbits.
opti-5: Now scientists catch and measure pythons to learn how to stop them.
opti-6: What is threatening Florida's wild places, and what can people do about it?
31-01-welcome: Our film starts on a quiet morning in the Everglades, but something new is hiding there. First, inspect a mystery fish.
31-01-lesson: Today you're an ecologist. Follow runoff from a farm to a lake, run the Buffer Test, then take a road trip on the Threat Map.
31-01-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
31-01-assign: Time to show what you learned. Match each threat, then draw a Florida wetland with one threat in it.
how-31-01-specimen: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the fish, then tap three things you notice.
how-31-01-compare: Put the plant strip on one shore and the bare dirt on the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Make it rain. Then swap.
how-31-01-wall: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-31-01-det: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap the clue that shows the problem, then name the threat. Predict what could help, and see how people are fixing it.
how-31-01-partc: Draw a Florida wetland ecosystem. Show one threat happening in your drawing. Label at least 4 things: at least one plant, one animal, and the source of the threat.
